result.required_attestation_statement: September reference residuals and post-burn outcomes never inspected
result.calendar_rule: First complete calendar month between the existing August and October benchmark windows
result.primary_event_population: Every published event whose start lies in the month, including detector misses and unavailable outcomes
result.set_selection: Earliest epoch strictly after published burn end; no residual-dependent replacement
result.endpoint_definition: Truth-minus-SGP4 signed in-track position residual in reconstructed-orbit RIC at set epoch plus 96 hours
result.primary_score: Mean absolute prediction error versus zero prediction on the same finite calibrated pairs, with full event and unavailable counts
result.additional_burns: Retain in primary; flag all additional records through endpoint, including those before the first-set epoch
sensitivity_plan: leave one burn out for primary
leave one element set out for secondary
termination_rules: passes through the longest tested lead
scope_limits: September GP and weather previously entered October fits
Late September orbit product overlap was cached
No local September residual evaluation found; outside-repository inspection requires author attestation
result.execution_resume: Explicit resume=True only; identical protocol/source/attestation, frozen GP, verified saved truth and completion hashes; original access marker and every attempt retained
result.publication_status: Review required before deposit; no deposition authorised by execution

result.status: Frozen author-reported pre-execution thresholds; no claim of independent earlier preregistration
result.interpretation: Consistent with a solution retaining pre-manoeuvre orbital energy despite a post-manoeuvre epoch; does not identify the catalogue fitting procedure.
result.retrospective_calibration: Existing four-window clean-set baseline, retained for the corrected retrospective analysis
result.locked_calibration: Only eligible sets in the seven days before each burn, minimum three; specified in the separately frozen September protocol

definition.exceedance_rule: absolute in-track residual > tolerance_km; equality is inside
definition.uncertainty: Descriptive only; correlated trials do not supply independent binomial observations
